name: ceramics-webapp
description: React single-page application serving both the shopper storefront (catalog, cart, guest/account checkout, order history) and the Store Admin area (catalog and stock management, order list), gated by role after Thunder sign-in. Talks only to the Ceramics API for data; holds no secrets and performs no payment or email logic itself.

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Ceramics API for catalog browsing, cart, checkout, order history, and admin catalog/order management.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder OIDC client used for optional shopper sign-in and required Store Admin sign-in via OIDC + PKCE.
